summary: A visible, accessible label and shared vertical rhythm for a list of independent Checkbox controls.
useWhen: Two or more related checkboxes need one visible group label in a form.
A checkbox list should use the same density-aligned heading geometry as other compact option lists.
avoidWhen: Only one standalone checkbox is needed.
Exactly one option may be selected; use Radio instead.

alternatives.when: Exactly one option may be selected.
alternatives.reason: Radio owns mutually exclusive selection and keyboard traversal.

accessibility: The visible label names the role=group container; each slotted Checkbox keeps its own visible label, state, focus, and form value.
Use aria-describedby to associate group-level guidance or validation copy.
Use the same size on CheckboxGroup and every slotted Checkbox so their text origins and density remain aligned.
states: The label uses the shared density section-heading row and body-small emphasis.
Vertical checkbox options use a 4px gap; at medium density the group label and each single-line checkbox row are 32px high.
Selection, mixed, inactive, validation, and form behavior remain owned by each slotted Checkbox.
responsiveBehavior: The group fills the width supplied by its parent while each Checkbox keeps its intrinsic row width and allows copy to wrap.

customElements: Slot two or more ds-checkbox children and keep their name, value, and checked state application-owned.
angular: Compose generated DsCheckbox adapters inside DsCheckboxGroup.

styling.rationale: The group owns only its label and option-list rhythm; each Checkbox owns its own selection anatomy.

protected.reason: Use size to keep the heading and slotted controls on the shared density recipe.
